faq.title: Frequently asked.
faq.a1: Yes — VocazAI handles modern standard Arabic, Moroccan darija, French and English. The agent switches between languages mid-call based on the caller.
faq.a2: Plan on 24 to 48 hours between your brief and the first call answered by your agent. No technical setup on your side.
faq.q3: What if the agent doesn't know the answer?
faq.a3: You define the transfer rules. The agent can take a message, schedule a callback, or transfer live to your team.
faq.a4: Yes. Recordings and transcripts are encrypted at rest, isolated per client (Postgres RLS), and exportable or deletable on demand.
